reviewed_answers.Q1: https://docs.stripe.com/payouts/instant-payouts-banks is Stripe’s institution-support directory for eligible Instant Payout users. In both captures the user selects a country and checks the destination type, including all-versus-some debit card or bank account distinctions, and must use the local currency. The Canadian list is for Visa or PLUS debit cards, UK accounts require an institution using Faster Payments, and applicable EU account sections say banks should support receiving SEPA Instant Payments. These are destination-selection rules. The directory records no payout submission, success or settlement transition. Compare old raw lines 4–21, 5671–5677, 6569–6577, 6805–6807 and 7255–7257 with new raw lines 5–20, 5670–5675, 6567–6574, 6795–6797 and 7231–7233. source-stripe-payouts-instant.md is the broader Dashboard guide summary.
